name: CloudMindMaps
description:
CloudMindMaps is free, browser-based mind mapping that's fully compatible with the open FreeMind/Freeplane .mm format. This connector lets Claude create, browse, and read mind maps directly in your CloudMindMaps account.

Ask Claude to turn meeting notes, a document, or a rough idea into a structured mind map — it builds the outline, the server generates a valid map, and you get a shareable link to open, edit, and collaborate on at cloudmindmaps.app. Anything you make here also opens in the FreeMind desktop apps.

Tools:
• Create mind map from an outline — Claude supplies a nested outline and the server generates a balanced, valid .mm map with a shareable URL.
• Create mind map from raw .mm XML — for advanced maps with clouds, edges, connectors, and rich nodes.
• List my mind maps — browse the maps you own or that are shared with you.
• Get a mind map — read a map's details and full content by ID.

Sign in with your Google account.
 Mind Maps are private to you by default; you choose what to share.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CloudMindMaps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CloudMindMaps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cloudmindmaps.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CloudMindMaps MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CloudMindMaps provides these MCP tools: create_mindmap, create_mindmap_from_outline, get_mindmap, and list_mindmaps.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CloudMindMaps?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CloudMindMaps in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
CloudMindMaps requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CloudMindMaps is developed by CloudMindMaps. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
